title: deployer: provision.declastruct --env sudo + aws.caller.get management guard
description:
## .what

let `provision.declastruct` run root (management-account) wishes, and promote two skills proven
in rhachet-roles-nheuron.

## .why

`--env` admits test, prep, prod, camp only. org, sso, scp, and budget wishes must run as the org
manager, whose profile lives in keyrack env `sudo`. a consumer today must hand-roll a wrapper —
nheuron did: `.agent/repo=.this/role=any/skills/provision.root.sh`.

## .the shape of the fix

1. **`provision.declastruct --env sudo`.** sudo keys sit in no keyrack.yml, so
   `keyrack unlock --env sudo` refuses without `--key`, and a wish-side
   `keyrack.source({ env: 'sudo' })` sees no keys. the skill must take `--key <name>`
   (repeatable; `AWS_PROFILE` always), unlock each, and export each into the declastruct process.
2. **promote `aws.caller.get --env <env> [--expect management]`** (nheuron
   `.agent/repo=.this/role=any/skills/aws.caller.get.sh`, already in deployer shape): the paved
   caller-identity check. `--expect management` refuses unless the account manages its org.
   it replaces every adhoc `aws sts get-caller-identity`.
3. **guard every root run.** call that check before any declastruct call. a wrong profile
   silently declares the org, sso, or budgets under the wrong account, and the wish cannot catch
   it — it learns the account FROM the credentials.

## .evidence

nheuron applied its accounts, sso, and spend-lockdown wishes through these on 2026-11-20. every
re-plan reads KEEP, budget actions aside (see the declastruct-aws dispatch).
